description: the Unstoppable, a living volcano in the shape of a giant warlord, her warm tanned human skin crossed by thin glowing cracks of yellow-white magma, a towering crown of jagged black obsidian horns with fire roaring between them, armour of black volcanic rock and molten gold plates, shoulders like erupting volcanic cones spewing sparks, a mantle of black smoke and glowing embers close behind her body, not reaching the edges, eyes blazing yellow-white, holding a colossal war axe whose blade is a sheet of liquid golden fire, a palette of obsidian black, ash grey, molten gold and white-hot yellow; adult woman, tall, strong and muscular, long wild red-brown hair in thick braids with iron rings, a fierce face; standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet, with everything around it, inside the image, the figure about three quarters of the image height, wide empty space above the head, below the feet and on both sides, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, mythic, overwhelming and radiant, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
